|value = 200 |gprice = 2500 }} The '''Aquamarine Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|2500}} after completing the [[Quests#Deeper In The Mine|Deeper in the Mine Quest]] (reaching level 40 in [[The Mines]]). It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]] or dropped from [[Haunted Skull]]s. It can also be found in [[Mystery Box]]es. The Aquamarine Ring increases [[Crit. Power|critical strike]] chance by 10%. For example, the [[Wicked Kris]] has a critical hit rate of 6%. With two Aquamarine Rings equipped, this increases to 7.2% (= 6% × 120%). ==Dyeing== Aquamarine Ring can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Aquamarin-Ring]] [[es:Anillo de acuamarina]] [[fr:Bague en aigue-marine]] [[it:Anello di acquamarina]] [[ja:アクアマリンの指輪]] [[ko:아쿠아마린 반지]] [[hu:Akvamarin gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de água-marinha]] [[ru:Кольцо с аквамарином]] [[tr:Gök Zümrütü Yüzük]] [[zh:海蓝宝石戒指]]
